class.name: EquipmentInstance
class.brief_description: One piece of equipment that is on a pawn right now.
class.description: Exists on every peer the [EquipmentManagerComponent] replicates to, with the same [method get_equipment_id], so each of them shows the spawned scenes and runs [method _on_equipped] / [method _on_unequipped]. Granting abilities, effects and tags is the server's part and happens before [method _on_equipped] runs there. Extend it in a script ([member EquipmentDefinition.instance_script]) for an item with logic of its own - a lamp that switches its light on, a tool that changes the character's pose.

method.name: _get_attach_parent
method.description: Return the node a spawned scene goes under, or [code]null[/code] for the default ([member EquipmentActorToSpawn.attach_to] and [member EquipmentActorToSpawn.attach_bone]).

method.name: _on_equipped
method.description: Called on every peer once the scenes are spawned.

method.name: _on_unequipped
method.description: Called on every peer before the scenes are freed.

method.name: get_equipment_id
method.description: The id naming this instance on every peer.

method.name: get_instigator
method.description: Whatever equipped it: on the server the [InventoryItemInstance]; on a client the mirror of that instance when this peer has the inventory, else [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_item_definition
method.description: The definition of the item it came from, on every peer.

method.name: get_item_id
method.description: The id of the [InventoryItemInstance] it came from, or [code]0[/code] when it was put on without one.

method.name: get_pawn
method.description: The node the manager sits under - the pawn's root.

method.name: get_spawned_nodes
method.description: The scenes it spawned, and the bone attachments made for them.

method.name: is_spawned_visible
method.description: Whether the spawned scenes are shown.

method.name: set_spawned_visible
method.description: Shows or hides every spawned scene on this peer, e.g. the axe while both hands carry a log.
